brand_strategy.what: Defining what a brand stands for and growing its equity, health and consistency over time.

campaign_management.what: Planning, launching and optimising marketing campaigns across channels.

demand_generation.what: Creating qualified pipeline for sales through demand programmes and account-based marketing.

performance_marketing.what: Running paid and digital acquisition channels (search, social, display) against efficiency targets.

seo_web_conversion.what: Growing unpaid search traffic and tuning the website and landing pages so more visitors convert.

content_social.what: Planning and producing content (blogs, video, social posts) that draws and engages an audience.

lifecycle_marketing.what: Reaching existing customers with email, in-app and CRM programmes that move them through the lifecycle.

marketing_analytics.what: Measuring what marketing spend returns: attribution, incrementality, channel and campaign performance.

consumer_insights.what: Turning research on consumer behaviour and attitudes into brand and marketing decisions.

creative_agency.what: Briefing and steering creative and media agencies to produce work that meets the brand's goals.

events_field_marketing.what: Planning events, trade shows, sponsorships and regional programmes that put the company in front of buyers.

pr_communications.what: Managing how the company is covered and heard: media relations, analyst relations and corporate communications.

customer_proof.what: Turning customer wins into case studies, references and advocacy that help sell.

cpg_innovation.what: Brand management as consumer-goods companies practise it: an innovation and renovation pipeline, plus shopper and trade marketing with retailers.
